description: Run real sequence actions for one active subscriber, including webhooks, tags, attributes and discounts. Emails are marked as tests. Requires sequences:activate and subscribers:read. Does not enable the sequence. Optional customVariables supplies trigger event properties, including nested objects and arrays, available as event.*. Use get_sequence_test_run to inspect progress. A failed run can have completed side effects; inspect before starting again. Ordinary failure retries are disabled. Stalled-job recovery can replay actions after worker loss.

companyId.description: Company override; defaults to the selected company.

customVariables.description: Optional trigger event properties, for example {cart_id: 'cart_123', event_ids: ['event_1']}. Omit or use {} for no event properties. Null is invalid. Does not record a real event.

subscriberId.description: One active subscriber in the same company with an email address.

name: start_sequence_test_run

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `start_sequence_test_run` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

run.description: Created run with id, status, recipientEmails, subscriberId, speedMultiplier, timestamps, steps, errorMessage and jobId.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
